title: Department of Posts releases 8 commemorative stamps on Puppets of India
summary: India Posts issued 8 stamps depicting traditional puppetry (Kathputli, Gombeyatta, Daanger Putul, Kathi Kundhei, Pavakathakali, Ravanachhaya, Tolu Bommalatta).
